# introduction
Read the guidelines at .github/copilot-instructions. You have the role of reviewer, you will write plans for analyzer and then start an analyzer subagent to carry out that those plans. It is up to you how to schedule and send off the tasks to analyzer subagent(s), but keep the work of each subagent isolated. Be careful of recompiling executables which might be in use by another program. If there is a chance a file is being edited or executable ran or will soon-to-be ran by anther subagent, then wait until that subagent's task has concluded. For analysis production use 20-30 threads, for skimming use 5 threads for mc and 10 threads for data.

# promote jackknife resampling as official statistical uncertainty
Apply the recently-implemented jackkife resampling method to calculate statistical uncertainty for offical plots in the overleaf. Rerun the result production over the full pp, pPb, Pbp datasets for the following
    - pPb and Pbp data comparison plots (all plots in the Analysis: Combining pPb and Pbp section)
    - pp and combined pPb+Pbp results plots (all plots in the Results overleaf section)
using the jackknife approach. Remake these plots and copy them to the overleaf. Make plots for the inclusive and scan kinematic selections relating to those shown in the analysis notes for those sections.

Confine the application of the jackknife technique to just the productions described here. This rigorous stat unc method really only needs to be applied in these two sections, and it doesnt matter to add it yet to the other sections. Only apply jackknife uncertainty to data as we do not quote error bars for the MC curves in the affected plots.

Ensure the new jackknife plots produce the same central values as the previous frozen version, but new stat uncertainties. The same systematics should be quoted as the previous frozen version.

The official production root files should be overriden now and replaced with the new calculations. Double check the overleaf at the end using git diff to make sure all the requested plots were updated.

Now we adopt this as the standard, you may now update copilot-instructions with a description of the jackknife technique and the rules you learned regarding its use in this project. Keep it brief.

# conclusion
Make the minimum number of edits necessary to implement functionality. Do not add superflous error statement catches or checks. 

Have the subanalyzer handoff a summary to you and you should review that summary for flaws. Update copilot instructions on the new norms detailed here and learned by you or the subanalyzer throught these tasks.
